name: Gros Morne National Park
policyReason: Pets are banned only from the top of Gros Morne Mountain and the Western Brook Pond boat tour; elsewhere they are allowed on leash.
summary: Leashed dogs can use most of the park, but not the top of Gros Morne Mountain or the Western Brook Pond boat tour.

excerpts.quote: All domestic animals must be kept on a leash at all times.
Not permitted on the top of Gros Morne Mountain.
Pets not permitted on the Western Brook Pond boat tour.

dogRules.text: Not permitted on the top of Gros Morne Mountain; dogs are not recommended on the Summit Trail.
No pets on the Western Brook Pond boat tour.
Off-leash dog park at Green Point Campground.
Some areas are closed to pets; check notices at trailheads.
Unattended tied-up animals may be impounded.
